# ResolveMeQ

> AI-powered IT support automation — deflect tickets, resolve faster, escalate with full context.

## Product

- [Marketing site](https://resolvemeq.net/): features, pricing, FAQ, contact
- [Web app](https://app.resolvemeq.net/knowledge-base): knowledge base and community Q&A
- [Documentation](https://resolvemeq.net/docs): product manual and setup guides
- [Journal / blog](https://resolvemeq.net/blog): product updates and IT operations content

## Public content for indexing

- Knowledge base articles: `https://app.resolvemeq.net/knowledge-base`
- Community Q&A: `https://app.resolvemeq.net/knowledge-base?view=community`
- Docs chapters: `https://resolvemeq.net/docs/*`
- Sitemap: `https://resolvemeq.net/sitemap.xml`
- RSS: `https://resolvemeq.net/rss.xml`
- Locale: English (`en`); see `/docs/SEO.md` for Search Console and prerender notes.
